system.description:
Choose two guards from below. You can mark a Stress to switch between them.

  • Crushing. When you roll a 1 on a damage die, treat it as the highest value on the die instead.
  • Defensive. Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage unless the adversary marks a Stress.
  • Grappling. On a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to make the target temporarily Restrained.
  • Showboating. When you succeed on an attack roll with Hope, roll a d4. On a 4, clear a Stress.
